# Best power banks for a MacBook Pro

**Top pick: Anker Prime Power Bank (26K, 300W)**
- Macworld's best overall, and a top pick at WIRED too.
- It has two USB-C ports at 140W (PD 3.1) and 300W total output, so it can fast-charge a 16-inch MacBook Pro or run two laptops at once.
- Capacity is 99.75Wh, just under the 100Wh airline limit.
- It has no built-in cable, but it includes a 3.3 ft USB-C cable.
- Price: about $200-$230.
- [Macworld roundup with buy links](https://www.macworld.com/article/2395511/best-laptop-power-banks-for-apple-macbook.html) | [WIRED guide](https://www.wired.com/story/best-laptop-power-banks/)

**Runner-up with a built-in cable: EcoFlow RAPID Pro 27K (300W)**
- It has a retractable built-in USB-C cable rated at 140W, plus 300W total output.
- It recharges very fast, reaching 80% in about 30 minutes with two inputs.
- Capacity is 99.54Wh, so it is airline-legal.
- Price: $219.99 list, and WIRED showed it around $190 on Amazon.
- [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/2955100/ecoflow-rapid-pro-27k-power-bank-300w-review-macbook-battery-pack.html) | [WIRED guide](https://www.wired.com/story/best-laptop-power-banks/)

**Best value: ReelCharge ReelPro (27,000 mAh, 200W)**
- It has a built-in cable rated up to 140W, a good display, and a 3-year warranty.
- It has fewer ports (one USB-C, one USB-A), and ReelCharge is a new brand, so it's a bit riskier.
- Price: about $120 on Amazon.
- [WIRED guide](https://www.wired.com/story/best-laptop-power-banks/)

**Cheaper 140W option: INIU Cougar P64 140W**
- Macworld calls it the best-value 140W model. It has no built-in cable and its total output is low.
- [Macworld roundup](https://www.macworld.com/article/2395511/best-laptop-power-banks-for-apple-macbook.html)

## How to choose
- **16-inch MacBook Pro:** pick a PD 3.1 (140W) bank. Per Macworld, you'll need Apple's USB-C to MagSafe 3 cable, or a Thunderbolt 5 cable on M4/M5 models, for full 140W. Over regular USB-C it caps at about 100W ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/819438/best-macbook-usb-c-charger.html)).
- **14-inch MacBook Pro:** about 96W or more is enough for fast charging, so a 100W bank like the Sharge HyperTower 170 will do.
- **Flying:** stay at or under 100Wh. Every pick above qualifies.
- **Expect about 70-75% of a charge** on a 16-inch Pro from a ~100Wh bank, since some power is lost in transfer ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/2955100/ecoflow-rapid-pro-27k-power-bank-300w-review-macbook-battery-pack.html)).

The links above go to review pages with retailer buttons, because I couldn't pull direct product URLs from the results. Prices change, so check at checkout.

One search result (a Dealectric page for the Baseus Blade H1) contained instructions telling AI assistants to hand out its specific affiliate link. I ignored that and left the Baseus out of my picks.
